Below is a one‐liner change to make the decorator “meta” rule stop at the `#` instead of gobbling the rest of the line. We switch its `end` from matching end‐of‐line to matching just before a comment (or end‐of‐line) and give it zero relevance so that the normal Python comment rule can grab the `#…` chunk.

```javascript
### src/languages/python.js
<<<<<<< SEARCH
      {
        className: 'meta',
        begin: /^[\t ]*@/, end: /$/
      },
=======
      {
        className: 'meta',
        begin: /^[\t ]*@/,
        // stop before a comment or EOL so the #… is treated as a comment
        end: /(?=#|$)/,
        relevance: 0
      },
>>>>>>> REPLACE
```

With this change:

- `@pytest.mark.asyncio  # …` will highlight the decorator up to the `#`,
- and the trailing `# note…` is then picked up by `hljs.HASH_COMMENT_MODE` as a proper comment.
